title: Employees must select a benefit plan before completing onboarding
description: As an Employee, I want the onboarding wizard to require a benefit plan selection before I can finish, so that I don't accidentally skip enrollment and end up without coverage.
raw_notes: Came out of the Growth-tier tenant pilot; two employees at Acme Corp completed onboarding without benefits selected because Finish was clickable early. Needs to be blocked in the UI, not just server-side validated.
